digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center reconciler backend and its port-contract conformance
propositions: JiraDataCenterBackend fails isinstance(Backend) on merged main because it is missing the query_project and assert_env_ready protocol members, which must be implemented in backend.py without weakening any contract assertion.
The reconciler.backend config validator only accepts {"jira"}, leaving the registered jira-datacenter backend unreachable through configuration until the choice set is widened.

query_project must return the configured project with no default substituted (empty when unset) so the inbound fetcher fails closed, and assert_env_ready must raise BackendEnvError naming each missing DC connection essential.

DC inbound assignees mint no ghost identity because the accountId guard returns early for DC users that carry only name/key, and mapping the vendor to the shared jira family channel is required so the mint validates against CREATION_CHANNELS without forking the store vocabulary.
The J2 import-boundary checker lacks a reciprocal rule preventing adapters/jira_datacenter modules from importing adapters/jira, and the clean-core-wheel check omits jira from the absent-module list.

A live writing reconcile pass against a real Jira DC instance crashes because the core calls set_entity_property, a method the TicketTransport protocol never declares and only the Cloud transport implements; writing-mode live criteria are relocated to J9 while dry-run passes.
